source_caption:
🎬 Ricky Stanicky (2024)

Ricky Stanicky follows three childhood best friends who invent a fictional troublemaker named Ricky Stanicky to take the blame whenever they get into trouble. Twenty years later, they are still using Ricky as an excuse to escape responsibilities, avoid uncomfortable situations, and enjoy secret adventures. However, when their families begin questioning whether Ricky actually exists, the friends hire a struggling actor named Rod to impersonate their imaginary companion. What begins as a simple plan quickly spirals into hilarious chaos when Rod takes his new identity far too seriously. Combining outrageous comedy, ridiculous misunderstandings, and unexpected heartfelt moments, the film explores friendship, dishonesty, responsibility, and the consequences of taking a lie too far.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Friendship

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 53m • R

🎥 Director: Peter Farrelly

🏆 Recognition: Starring Zac Efron, John Cena, Jermaine Fowler, and Andrew Santino, the film gained attention for John Cena’s outrageous comedic performance and its hilarious premise.

📺 Where to Watch: Amazon Prime Video. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Ricky Stanicky is a 2024 comedy film co-written and directed by Peter Farrelly. The film stars Zac Efron, Jermaine Fowler, Andrew Santino, Lex Scott Davis, Anja Savcic, Jeff Ross, William H. Macy, and John Cena. The story follows a group of childhood friends who, after inventing a fictional person named Ricky Stanicky to escape trouble, continue using the fake identity into adulthood. When their families begin to question Ricky's existence, they hire an eccentric actor to impersonate him, resulting in unexpected consequences.
